context_files_read.purpose: controlling repository instructions and safety constraints
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; reports are views only.
Harness controls, schemas, scripts, docs, templates, gate locks, and workflows must not be weakened.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN must not run unless the user explicitly opts in.
Missing values must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and never invented.

context_files_read.purpose: phase loop and P14 opt-in boundary
key_findings: Automatic completion stops at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14 requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN=I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_IS_NOT_A_DEFAULT_GATE and remains dry-run only.
Gate results must be produced by scripts/codex_gate.py run, not manual PASS edits.
The automatic loop stops after P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is explicitly not automatic.
L01 must audit committed P00-P13 required artifacts and gate state without running P14.
P13 must not be excluded solely due to historical command mismatch; the mismatch must be a finding.
P14 must be identified as opt-in dry-run and must not count as real 1000-node Valkey evidence.
Empty JSON, missing schema, missing producer, missing run_id, and missing status must be detected.
requirements_analyst must only do requirements and gap analysis.

The subagent artifact must use schema_version v1, stage_id, agent_role, context_files_read, findings, proposed_harness, implementation_plan, acceptance_criteria, risks, forbidden_shortcuts, commands_to_run, verdict, and notes.
L01 must establish a committed artifact audit hard gate.

Required L01 harness files are scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py, schemas/artifact/audit_report.schema.json, tests/audit/test_committed_artifact_audit.py, and tests/ci/test_committed_artifact_audit_gate.py.
Acceptance requires P00-P13 required artifact auditability, P13 mismatch classification, P14 opt-in dry-run classification, and detection of empty JSON or missing schema/producer/run_id/status.
L01 audit validation command is python3 scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json.
L01 tests must include python3 -m pytest -q tests/audit and python3 -m pytest -q tests/ci/test_committed_artifact_audit_gate.py.
Dry-run 1000 artifacts must not count as real Valkey coverage.
L01 must persist subagent outputs, commands, validation result, anti-regression output, stage result, and reports under artifacts/loop_engineering.
Command results must be captured as JSONL, not only described in chat.

P00-P13 are automatic and have required_artifacts; P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is automatic=false.
P03-P13 require real Valkey evidence; P13 requires 50-node and 100-node real e2e gates.
P14 requires the explicit opt-in env var and dry-run resource/planner outputs only.
Committed gate results exist for P00 through P13 and P13 optimization stages; all inspected top-level statuses are PASS.
Gate result artifacts carry runner, manifest_sha256, gate commands, statuses, exit codes, log paths, and log hashes.
Top-level gate_result artifacts do not carry run_id or producer; L01 must decide and record whether that is schema-accepted metadata debt or a blocking audit condition.
Required P00-P13 phase artifacts listed in the manifest are present in the committed artifact tree.
Required phase artifacts generally include schema_version, artifact_type, phase_id, producer, run_id, and status.

Several non-required support artifacts such as state_*.json, fault spec JSON files, normalized config JSON files, cluster snapshot arrays, and some P13 optimization artifacts lack one or more top-level metadata fields; L01 must classify these instead of hiding them.
Audit decisions exist for P00-P13 and P13 optimization stages and report PASS.
Audit decisions include gate_result_path, gate_result_sha256, artifact_paths, fresh_context, auditor, decision, risks, and rationale.
Audit decision schema does not require producer or run_id; the L01 audit report should make that metadata rule explicit.

This artifact is not P14 execution evidence and must not be counted as real 1000-node Valkey coverage.
L00_LOOP_ENGINE_HARNESS_BOOTSTRAP is PASS and pushed.
The current stage is L01_EXISTING_ARTIFACT_AUDIT_HARD_GATE.

findings.description: There is no committed artifact audit hard gate yet. L01 must add a machine-readable audit report and harness that validates committed P00-P13 required artifacts from the manifest rather than relying on Markdown audits or chat summaries.
evidence: codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py, schemas/artifact/audit_report.schema.json, tests/audit/test_committed_artifact_audit.py, and tests/ci/test_committed_artifact_audit_gate.py.
codex/loop_engineering/05_VALIDATION_COMMANDS.md requires python3 scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json.
artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/L01_EXISTING_ARTIFACT_AUDIT_HARD_GATE/read_context.md states the audit must be artifact-first.

findings.description: P00-P13 automatic required artifacts must be audited as a complete manifest-derived set, including schema path, existence, non-empty JSON/JSONL status, schema validation, phase_id, artifact_type, producer, run_id, and status where applicable.
evidence: codex/phase_manifest.json marks P00-P13 automatic=true and lists required_artifacts for every automatic phase.
find artifacts/phases -maxdepth 2 showed committed required artifact files for P00 through P13.
schemas/artifact/*.schema.json generally require run_id, producer, and status for required phase artifacts.

findings.description: P13 must remain in scope even with a historical gate command mismatch. The audit must compare manifest commands to committed gate_result commands, classify mismatches explicitly, and distinguish blocking mismatches from historical/non-blocking mismatches.
evidence: codex/phase_manifest.json currently defines P13 scale_tests as python3 -m pytest -q tests/unit tests/scale tests/integration -m 'not slow and not perf'.
artifacts/gates/P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100/gate_result.json records P13 scale_tests as python3 -m pytest -q tests/unit tests/scale tests/integration.
artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/L01_EXISTING_ARTIFACT_AUDIT_HARD_GATE/read_context.md explicitly says P13 must not be excluded solely due to historical command mismatch.

findings.description: P14 must be represented as an opt-in dry-run boundary, not as automatic phase coverage or real 1000-node Valkey evidence. The audit must flag any P14 real execution evidence or automatic treatment as blocking.
evidence: codex/phase_manifest.json sets P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN automatic=false, real_valkey_required=false, max_nodes=1000, and requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
CODEX_START_HERE.md states P14 may only run after explicit opt-in and the required environment variable.
artifacts/phases/P02_PLANNER/scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json is dry_run=true and no_execution=true, so it is planner evidence only.

findings.description: The audit must detect and classify metadata gaps across committed artifacts. Required phase artifacts should fail if schema, producer, run_id, or status is missing; support artifacts and schemas that intentionally omit those fields must be reported with explicit classification.
evidence: schemas/artifact/gate_result.schema.json requires runner and status but not producer or run_id.
schemas/artifact/audit_decision.schema.json requires decision and audit metadata but not producer or run_id.

Existing support artifacts such as state_*.json and some P13 optimization artifacts lack top-level producer, run_id, or status; L01 must not silently treat them as equivalent to schema-valid required phase artifacts.

findings.description: The audit tool must be robust to JSON objects, JSON arrays, JSONL files, missing files, invalid JSON, zero-byte files, and empty object/array artifacts. It must not assume every artifact has a top-level object shape.
evidence: Required observability artifacts include JSONL files: metrics_timeseries.jsonl and events.jsonl.
Cluster snapshot files are JSON arrays, so naive top-level object metadata checks fail on them.
A direct zero-byte scan found no current zero-byte JSON/JSONL artifacts, but L01 acceptance requires test fixtures for empty JSON detection.

findings.description: The audit report schema must force findings to be machine-readable, severity-tagged, phase-linked, and actionable. A single PASS field without per-artifact and per-gate evidence would be too weak for L01.
evidence: AGENTS.md says no phase may pass without required artifacts, schema validation, gate logs, and an audit decision.
codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires explicit findings for P13 historical mismatch and P14 dry-run classification.
codex/loop_engineering/06_STATE_AND_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md requires persisted machine-readable stage artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: committed_artifact_audit_ci_gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: tests/ci/test_committed_artifact_audit_gate.py asserts the audit CLI, audit report schema, and tests/audit are wired into the repository validation path without invoking P14 or real Valkey gates.

implementation_plan.step: Define the L01 audit report contract before implementation.
implementation_plan.rationale: The audit report must be schema-first and strong enough to prevent empty reports, unclassified mismatches, or dry-run evidence from passing silently.

implementation_plan.step: Design the audit CLI to read manifest, gate results, phase artifacts, schemas, and audit decisions.
implementation_plan.rationale: The audit must derive expected artifacts from codex/phase_manifest.json and inspect committed machine-readable artifacts directly.

implementation_plan.step: Add focused tests for manifest coverage, P13 command mismatch classification, P14 dry-run boundary, and metadata/empty artifact detection.
implementation_plan.rationale: These are the L01 requirement gaps and must be executable before any implementation is considered acceptable.

implementation_plan.step: Add CI wiring tests for the new committed artifact audit gate.
implementation_plan.rationale: The audit gate must persist beyond the local stage and must not invoke P14 or expensive real Valkey gates in CI.

implementation_plan.step: Write the generated audit report only through the audit CLI.
implementation_plan.rationale: The output artifact must be machine-generated and reproducible from committed inputs, not handwritten.

acceptance_criteria: The L01 audit report is produced at artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json and validates against schemas/artifact/audit_report.schema.json.
The report includes every automatic phase P00_REPO_CONTRACT through P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 and every manifest required_artifacts entry for those phases.

For each required P00-P13 artifact, the report records path, schema path, exists, empty, parse mode, schema_valid, artifact_type, phase_id, producer presence, run_id presence, status presence/value, sha256, and finding ids.

Missing, zero-byte, invalid JSON/JSONL, missing schema, schema-invalid, missing producer, missing run_id, or missing status on a required artifact is a blocking finding unless the report explicitly proves the manifest/schema does not require that field.

Gate results are checked for presence, schema validity, top-level status, required gate statuses, manifest command comparison, stdout/stderr path existence, and stdout/stderr sha256 consistency when possible.

P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 is included even if the scale_tests command differs from the current manifest; the mismatch is recorded with actual command, expected command, classification, severity, and blocking flag.
P13 real evidence remains evaluated against real_valkey=true, probe_result=PASS, Valkey version prefix 9.1., data_path_result=PASS, and nodes_observed or role_counts sufficient for 50 and 100 nodes.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is present in the report as automatic=false, opt_in_required=true, dry_run_only=true, not_required_for_automatic_completion=true, and real_valkey_coverage=false.
Existing P02 1000-node dry-run plan artifacts are classified as planner dry-run evidence only and never counted as P14 completion or real 1000-node Valkey evidence.
Audit decision files for P00-P13 are checked for existence, schema validity, decision, fresh_context, gate_result_path, gate_result_sha256, and artifact_paths coverage.
tests/audit includes synthetic fixtures that prove empty JSON, empty array JSON, invalid JSON, missing schema, missing producer, missing run_id, and missing status are detected.
tests/ci/test_committed_artifact_audit_gate.py verifies the CLI, schema, and tests are part of the validation path and that the validation path does not run P14.
L01 must not mutate existing historical gate results or phase artifacts to hide audit findings.
risks: A too-loose audit_report schema could allow a report with no per-artifact evidence to pass.
A naive metadata checker could falsely fail valid JSON arrays or JSONL artifacts, or falsely pass empty objects with required metadata missing.
Historical P13 command mismatch could be hidden by excluding P13 from the audit; this must be blocked.
P02 1000-node dry-run plan could be misrepresented as P14 evidence or real 1000-node coverage.
Adding CI coverage for the audit gate could accidentally run P14 or real Valkey scale gates; CI should validate committed artifacts only.
Changing phase_manifest, old gate results, or old audit decisions to make the audit clean would violate the harness integrity rules.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN for L01.
Do not count dry-run planner/resource artifacts as real Valkey evidence.
Do not skip P13 because of a historical command mismatch.
Do not edit historical gate_result.json or audit_decision.json files to remove mismatches or metadata gaps.
Do not weaken codex/phase_manifest.json, schemas, pre-authored scripts, docs, templates, or workflows to make artifacts pass.
Do not infer artifact validity from Markdown reports when machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts are available.
Do not treat missing producer, run_id, status, or schema as acceptable without an explicit machine-readable classification.
Do not handwrite PASS into gate results or the generated audit report.
notes: This requirements analysis intentionally does not implement code. L01 should proceed only after harness_architect and risk_auditor produce compatible artifacts; implementation must be limited to the L01 audit harness and generated report, with historical committed artifacts left intact.
